item.title: Trump on whether Americans should fear Iran reprisals in US: 'I guess'
item.description: “We think about it all the time. We plan for it. But yeah, you know, we expect some things. Like I said, some people will die. When you go to war, some people will die.”

item.title: Fort Bend County deputy killed in hit-and-run to be laid to rest Friday
item.description: Authorities are still looking for clues into the deadly hit-and-run crash that took the life of a Fort Bend County deputy last month.

item.title: Cedar Park scout earns 141 merit badges, a vanishingly rare achievement
item.description: Less than 700 scouts in scouting history earned all of the merit badges, and just 15 of those were girls.

item.title: Daylight Saving Time begins this weekend
item.description: We are springing forward this weekend and turning our clocks back an hour which means you will lose an hour of sleep but gain more daylight overall.

item.title: Former Democratic presidents remember the late Rev. Jesse Jackson during final public tribute
item.description: Former President Barack Obama said the presidential runs in the 1980s by the late Rev. Jesse Jackson Sr. set the stage for other Black leaders, including himself.

item.title: Spotty rain today, severe storms possible tomorrow
item.description: The first day of March will bring warm, sunny weather to southeast Texas after some morning fog.

item.title: Weekend construction: Closures that will impact your weekend drive
item.description: Expect traffic delays along I-69 in Fort Bend County and Katy Freeway near downtown Houston this weekend due to construction and major traffic switch.

item.title: Texans release running back Joe Mixon after missing entire 2025 season
item.description: The Houston Texans have released running back Joe Mixon after he missed the entire 2025 season with a foot injury.

item.title: Amidst Trump endorsement battle, Paxton and Cornyn fight over SAVE America Act
item.description: President Donald Trump has announced he will endorse a candidate in the Texas Senate primary runoff, and incumbent Sen. John Cornyn and challenger Attorney General Ken Paxton are sparring online about who is most likely to secure Trump's agenda.

item.title: Plane from Houston that crashed in Maine spent more time on runway than recommended after deicing, NTSB says
item.description: A preliminary report shows that a Houston private jet that crashed in Maine in January remained on the ground 8 minutes longer than it should have after receiving a deicing treatment during a snowstorm.
